toolsPreview.name: list_news
toolsPreview.description: List recent pro-wrestling news headlines aggregated by The Daily Smark, featured and newest first. Returns markdown links back to the original publisher, never the full article text. Keep the links in your answer so the reader can open the story. Covers roughly the last 30 days.

toolsPreview.name: list_videos
toolsPreview.description: List recent pro-wrestling videos collected by The Daily Smark, featured and newest first. Returns markdown links back to the original channel. Keep the links in your answer so the reader can watch the video.

toolsPreview.name: list_podcasts
toolsPreview.description: List recent pro-wrestling podcast episodes featured by The Daily Smark. Returns markdown links back to the episode. Keep the links in your answer so the reader can go and listen.

toolsPreview.name: get_tv_schedule
toolsPreview.description: Get the pro-wrestling TV schedule: which shows air on which days, on which channels. Use this to answer "what is on tonight/this week".

toolsPreview.name: list_live_events
toolsPreview.description: List upcoming live pro-wrestling events (house shows and pay-per-views) with their venues. Use this to answer "is anything coming to my area".

toolsPreview.name: get_event
toolsPreview.description: Get the full detail for one pro-wrestling event by its unique id, including venue and card preview. Get the id from get_tv_schedule or list_live_events first.
